description: This Java test class verifies the immutability, equality, and resolution behavior of the ImmutablePolicyPlaceholder class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders package. It contains unit tests that confirm the immutable nature of the class, proper equals and hashCode implementations, and the correct resolution of placeholders using POLICY_ID details.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyPlaceholderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of ImmutablePolicyPlaceholder, ensuring its immutability, correct equals/hashCode implementations, and proper placeholder resolution.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that ImmutablePolicyPlaceholder instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the hashCode and equals methods of ImmutablePolicyPlaceholder using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: testReplacePolicyId
methods.description: Tests the resolution of POLICY_ID placeholder by replacing 'policy_id' in the placeholder string with its string representation.

methods.name: testReplacePolicyName
methods.description: Tests placeholder resolution for 'name' of the POLICY_ID.

methods.name: testReplacePolicyNamespace
methods.description: Tests placeholder resolution for 'namespace' of the POLICY_ID.

methods.name: testUnknownPlaceholderReturnsEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that an unknown placeholder key returns an empty Optional.
